description: Subscribe to daily re-checks of one x402 seller URL for 30 days. Alerts your webhook and/or email when payTo, price, network, or availability changes. Fixed $5 USDC Exact (not per-check). Optional after a one-shot preflight when you will revisit the same seller.

email.description: Optional email for change alerts via Resend (also set webhookUrl if you want an HTTPS webhook)

url.description: Absolute https URL of the x402 seller endpoint (the resource you are about to pay)

webhookUrl.description: https URL that receives POST JSON alerts on change

name: watch_tool
